# Disagreement Log — Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 37

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Chapter:** SHE 037 — Mandate 7 (Fear God, Not the Devil)
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

### 1. V. 1 — "your every deed will be incomparable" vs. "your deeds will be beyond compare"
- **EMET:** "your every deed will be incomparable"
- **LOGOS:** "your deeds will be beyond compare"
- **PNEUMA:** "what you do will be incomparable"
- **Decision:** "your deeds will be beyond compare" — anenantios = unequaled/beyond comparison; LOGOS phrasing is clearest

### 2. V. 2 — "fear which you ought to have to be saved" vs. "fear that leads to salvation" vs. "kind of fear that saves you"
- **EMET:** "fear which you ought to have to be saved"
- **LOGOS:** "fear that leads to salvation"
- **PNEUMA:** "kind of fear that saves you"
- **Decision:** "fear you ought to have, the fear that leads to salvation" — LOGOS; the distinction between the two aspects of fear (of God / of devil) is the mandate's point

### 3. V. 3 — "have dominion over the devil" vs. "have mastery over the devil"
- **EMET:** "have dominion over the devil"
- **LOGOS:** "have mastery over the devil"
- **PNEUMA:** "have power over the devil"
- **Decision:** "have mastery over the devil" — kratein = have power/mastery; "dominion" is slightly archaic

### 4. V. 5 — The subtle distinction: fear the devil's deeds but not the devil himself
- All three preserve this distinction but phrase it differently
- **Decision:** SOPHIA synthesis: "Fear then the deeds of the devil... but fearing the works of the Lord and keeping his commandments"

**Total disagreements: 3**
